svg.title: Hook — cyclops robot
svg.desc: An orange cyclops robot with a tall dome head holding one large eye in a slate ring, side bolts and a slate collar, a wide rounded pill body with a chest dial and two lights, slate shoulder pads with jointed arms reaching down to hooks near the ground, and two straight legs on round slate feet.
